title: Assistant Town Planner
description:
Job Title: Assistant Town Planner

Ref: BM332

Location: Maidstone

Salary: £29,000 - £35,000

This is a fantastic opportunity to join one of the UKs leading independent planning consultancy who provide a wide range of expertise to the residential, industrial, commercial, education, and healthcare sectors. They are on the lookout for an enthusiastic and talented Assistant Town Planner to join their growing team in Maidstone.

Benefits for the role of Assistant Town Planner include:
- Highly competitive salary
- Contributory pension scheme
- Hybrid working
- Generous holiday allowance
- Professional development
- Personal development

Duties for the role of Assistant Town Planner:
- Assisting with the preparation and submission of planning applications
- Undertaking research into planning policy, legislation and guidance
- Reviewing local and national planning policies and identifying their implications for development proposals
- Assisting with planning appraisals and development feasibility assessments
- Supporting the preparation of planning statements, reports and other technical documents
- Liaising with local planning authorities, consultants, clients and other stakeholders
- Monitoring planning applications and assisting with the management of project programmes
- Attending meetings, site visits and planning committees where appropriate

Requirements for the role of Assistant Town Planner:
- RTPI Accredited degree within town planning or another related discipline
- Relevant experience within a planning consultancy, local authority or related planning environment, although strong graduates will also be considered
- An understanding of the UK planning system and relevant planning policy
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- Excellent research, analytical and organisational abilities
- The ability to manage multiple tasks and work to deadlines
- Good attention to detail
- Confidence communicating with colleagues, clients and external stakeholders
- A proactive approach and willingness to learn
- A genuine interest in the built environment, development and planning

If this role interests you or if you are interested in searching for other roles relating to Town Planning please feel free to contact Ben Moore on or email . There are many more roles available on our website at . This is a permanent role

title: Logistics Coordinator - Operations & Quality
company: Pearson Whiffin Recruitment Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Logistics Coordinator - Quality and Operations

£30,000 - £31,000

Monday to Friday, office-based position

Mid Kent

We are currently supporting a well-established manufacturing business in the Maidstone area with the recruitment of a Logistics & Quality Coordinator.

This is a varied role suited to someone who enjoys a combination of coordination, administration and hands-on operational work. You'll work closely with teams across the business, including production, warehouse and logistics, helping to ensure orders are prepared and dispatched accurately and on time.

The role would suit someone with experience in dispatch, logistics, warehouse administration or manufacturing, who is comfortable working across both office and operational environments.

Duties:
- Coordinating deliveries and collections with transport providers
- Preparing shipping and delivery documentation and keeping records up to date
- Using an ERP system to process orders, stock movements and dispatch information
- Carrying out basic quality and quantity checks before goods are dispatched
- Monitoring stock levels and supporting inventory checks
- Liaising with customers and internal teams regarding deliveries and order requirements
- Supporting the warehouse and production teams with picking, packing and preparing goods for dispatch
- Investigating and escalating any delivery, quality or operational issues
- Producing basic reports and maintaining accurate administration
- Working in line with company health and safety procedures

What We're Looking For:

We're looking for someone who is naturally organised, practical and enjoys working in a busy environment. You don't need to have experience in every part of the role, but you'll ideally bring some experience from a logistics, dispatch, manufacturing or warehouse setting.

You'll be confident using computer systems, comfortable dealing with different people throughout the day and have a good eye for detail. Experience with SAP or another stock/ERP system would be useful.

The role also has a hands-on element, so you'll need to be happy getting involved on the operational side rather than being purely office-based. Experience with deliveries, transport companies, stock or quality checks would be a bonus.

Most importantly, we're looking for someone reliable, proactive and willing to get stuck in.

This role is being handled by Holly Ensoll and Chloe Wadhams Recruitment Consultant for Pearson Whiffin Recruitment.

Not quite the right role but still looking?

Whether you are entry or Executive level, our team of experienced Recruitment specialists can help you with your career. We are Kent's leading independent consultancy and pride ourselves on delivering an exceptional service to both candidates and clients.

title: Administrator
company: Kent and Medway Mental Health NHS Trust
advertiser_name: Kent and Medway Mental Health NHS Trust
description: This office-based role provides a high level of administration support to the Maidstone and Pembury Liaison Psychiatry Service in its 24-hour provision of mental health assessments for individuals who attend the Emergency Department or are admitted on medical/surgical wards and have mental health needs. The post may provide back-up support to the other West Kent hospital site, which may require very occasional travel to Tunbridge Wells Hospital - most of this support can be provided remotely from Maidstone Hospital. Provide comprehensive admin support to the team/service. Support the team manager with staffing levels, covering shifts and booking NHSP bank/agency staff. Answer telephone calls and take messages or divert to the relevant person. Provide support with caseload management using Rio, including monitoring to ensure all mandatory documentation has been completed. Monitor various data sources to ensure accuracy. Monitor Business Intelligence reports for performance compliance and highlight and rectify any errors. Ensure resources (such as forms, leaflets, documents) and supplies for the team are replenished and ordered in a timely manner. Keep accurate and up-to-date service data records. Send invites and produce meeting agendas, minutes other meeting papers. Maintain and update information resources in the office. Please refer to the attached job description for the full details on the responsibilities and person specification.
